comment: K1 atlas cell map, Kenney edition: every cell resolves to ONE PNG file under src/iso/kenny (individual RGBA PNGs — no sheets, no blue key, no PNML, no crops). Each cell carries: name, png (repo path relative to src/iso/kenny), kind, footprint. kind: 'ground' = a flat Kenney block (132x64 diamond + 50px skirt) — the packer anchors it by its measured widest row and REJECTS it unless that row sits at y~32 with ~full width (the spec's flat-only filter: slope/ramp tiles fail); 'standing' = a building, anchored by the widest row of its base diamond so it stands flush on the tile; 'vehicle' = anchored bottom-centre on the tile surface. Anchors are always COMPUTED by the packer from the pixels — there is no hand-authored anchor, box, crop, compose, sprite-id, layer or generator field anywhere in this file. Derived art (rail set, crossing, placement glows) is pre-drawn by tools/make-derived-art.mjs into src/iso/kenny/derived and referenced like any Kenney PNG.
